integrity: The complete all-parameter proof is analytic and self-contained. Bounded independent enumeration supports but does not replace proof. No independent validation or external formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform spanning trees of simple generalized-theta graphs with at least three internally disjoint terminal paths, each of length at least two; stochastic comparisons fix the number and total length of paths. No assertion for arbitrary weighted graphs or other series-parallel networks. Historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Stochastic leaf-count monotonicity under balancing in multi-theta spanning trees
